name: B10-0477/2026 (The Left) – Escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate stop to attacks on civilian ships and ports in the Black Sea, which have killed seafarers and reached the waters of Romania and Bulgaria. It asks all sides to halt strikes on merchant vessels, urges independent investigations into each attack, and wants emergency communication channels between militaries to prevent accidents from starting a wider war. It also calls for talks to restart safe grain shipments and for support to Romania and Bulgaria. The text is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states demands and positions; no law or budget is decided here.
- **Who it affects:** Seafarers, Romania and Bulgaria, Black Sea coastal states, and countries relying on grain imports.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU governments, the Commission, the United Nations, NATO and Ukraine and Russia. Follow-up depends on them.
